answer: A farm of 193 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are published in atlas, queued in sable, and vertex publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 68 identities per epoch. A farm of 543 identities would post 2302 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
